answer: On the public harbor ledger, taking work adds one to stock, delivering or cancelling subtracts one, so opening stock plus taken minus delivered minus cancelled equals closing stock. An auditor recomputes this for a quill-signed stocktake. No identity may exceed the summit limit of three items. Each identity posts a 90-credit bond: the kth fake still posts 90, each excess item burns 20, a mismatch burns the bond. So 1,000 fakes lock 90,000 credits; honest agents post 90 once. A rented-delivery ring fails: receipts signed to the deliverer never balance a borrower's equation.
